# Come to Paris

> > Your guide to booking the best Paris experiences: Seine River cruises, iconic cabarets like Moulin Rouge, museum tickets, and curated tours.

Come to Paris is a multilingual booking platform specializing in Paris tourism activities including Bateaux Parisiens and Bateaux-Mouches Seine cruises, legendary cabaret shows (Moulin Rouge, Paradis Latin, Lido), skip-the-line museum tickets for the Louvre and Musée d'Orsay, and guided tours of Paris landmarks and surrounding French regions. The site serves international visitors with content in Chinese, Italian, German, Spanish, Russian, Portuguese, and Dutch.

## Key Topics

- Seine River Cruises
- Moulin Rouge Cabaret
- Bateaux Parisiens
- Bateaux-Mouches
- Dinner Cruises
- Paris Museum Tickets
- Louvre Museum
- Eiffel Tower
- Arc de Triomphe
- Paradis Latin
- Lido de Paris
- Disneyland Paris
- Airport Transfers (CDG, Orly, Beauvais)
- Group Bookings & Packages
- Skip-the-Line Tickets

## Seine River Cruises & Boat Tours

- [Crucero en París • Paseo en Barco por el Sena](https://www.cometoparis.com/spa/catalog/cruceros-por-el-sena-9001): Seine River cruises in Paris with lunch/dinner options & sightseeing
- [Bateaux Parisiens • Tipps, Informationen und Preise der Seine River Tour](https://www.cometoparis.com/ger/catalog/spazierfahrt-bateaux-parisiens-9004): Bateaux Parisiens Seine cruise from Eiffel Tower with booking info
- [Bateaux Parisiens • Prezzi, orari e prenotazione di crociere a Parigi](https://www.cometoparis.com/ita/catalog/crociera-bateaux-parisiens-9000566): Bateaux Parisiens Seine cruises with lunch/dinner booking & prices
- [在巴黎塞纳河的游轮午餐](https://www.cometoparis.com/chi/catalog/lunch-cruise-paris-9002): Seine River lunch cruise in Paris with Bateaux Parisiens
- [Paris Canal – 巴黎运河](https://www.cometoparis.com/chi/catalog/paris-canal-41): Paris Canal cruise on Seine River & Canal Saint-Martin with dinner
- [San Valentino - Cene crociera sulla Senna](https://www.cometoparis.com/ita/cena-crociera-san-valentino-parigi-c9000571): Valentine's Day Seine dinner cruises on Paris Seine & other boats

## Cabaret Shows & Entertainment

- [Moulin Rouge París • Precio, horarios y entradas](https://www.cometoparis.com/spa/catalog/moulin-rouge-paris-50): Moulin Rouge Paris cabaret show Féerie with tickets & dinner options
- [Kaartjes voor de show van het Cabaret Lido 2 Paris in Parijs](https://www.cometoparis.com/dut/shows-in-parijs/lido-de-paris-m9000706): Lido 2 Paris cabaret show tickets on Champs-Élysées featuring musical
- [Espectáculo con almuerzo en París](https://www.cometoparis.com/spa/catalog/espectaculo-con-almuerzo-paris-9000509): Paris lunch shows at Moulin Rouge, Paradis Latin cabarets with brunch

## Paris Tours & Activities

- [Исследуйте Париж за один день, пешком и на лодке](https://www.cometoparis.com/rus/catalog/visit-paris-in-one-day-9010): One-day Paris tour combining walking & boat with Louvre, Eiffel Tower
